column1: # Per-proteome override of which GO release GAF scripts/download_fullgo.py downloads for a
# species. Two whitespace-separated columns: PANTHER proteome (OSCODE) and source, where
# source is "uniprot" or "mod". Trailing # comments carry the rationale.
# Proteomes NOT listed here follow the global default: -uniprot normally, or -mod wherever a
# -mod.gaf.gz exists under PREFER_MOD_GAFS=1 (download_fullgo.py --prefer_mod). So this file
# reads as an always-mod list under the plain default and as a never-mod list under the flag.
# Why any of this exists: PANTHER cannot map every MOD ID namespace back to UniProt, and a
# -mod GAF whose namespace does not map produces almost no rows in Pthr_GO_<version>.tsv.
# Breakage is per-proteome, not per-namespace - XENTR is also Xenbase and came through fine.
# Verify any change here with `make compare_pthr_go_counts` before loading the DB.
# Counts below are Pthr_GO_19.0.tsv annotation rows, 2026-07-27 -> 2026-08-10, when ECOLI,
# XENLA and SCHJY were switched to -mod.
